name: Packmaster (Scout Archetype)
body:
Some scouts work in tandem with trained beasts.

Operating as one lethal unit whether confronting foes directly or fighting behind enemy lines.

Trainer (Ex)

At 1st level, the pack master adds 1/2 their class level to all Handle Animal checks.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Hunting Pack (Ex)

At 1st level, a packmaster forms a close bond with an animal companion. This animal companion functions as a druid’s animal companion, using the scout’s level as their effective druid level. They can choose either a bird or a dog, or similar animals as allowed by their GM, when selecting their animal companion.

The packmaster can have more than one animal companion, but they must divide up their effective druid level between their companions to determine the abilities of each companion. Each time a packmaster’s effective druid level increases, they must decide how to allocate the increase among their animal companions, including the option of adding a new 1st-level companion. Once an effective druid level is allocated to a particular companion, it cannot be redistributed while that companion is in the packmaster’s service.

They must release a companion or wait until a companion dies to allocate its levels to another companion. The share spells animal companion ability does not give the packmaster the ability to cast a single spell so that it affects all of their animal companions. In such a case, they must select one companion to benefit.

A packmaster’s animal companions gain a bonus on Survival checks to follow tracks equal to 1/2 the packmaster’s class level (minimum 1).

This ability replaces all iterations of sneak attack.

Pack Deeds (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, your animal companion(s) can use the packmaster’s grit pool to perform deeds and benefit from the deeds that require at least 1 grit point remaining. Additionally, if the animal companion(s) score a critical hit or reduce creature to 0 after moving at least 10 feet, the packmaster regains a point of grit.

This ability modifies deeds but does not prevent another archetype from changing or removing specific deeds.

Pack Tricks (Ex)

At 4th level, a packmaster’s dog, or dog-type, can make a free trip or dirty trick (entangled) combat maneuver after a successful melee attack. A packmaster’s bird, or bird-type, can make a free dirty trick (dazzled or deafened) combat maneuver after a successful melee attack; if the target is already dazzled, the bird can choose dirty trick (blinded) instead. These combat maneuvers do not provoke attacks of opportunity.

This ability replaces hit and run.

Pack Attack (Ex)

At 9th level, whenever a packmaster and any of their animal companion(s) are adjacent and attack the same target in melee, they are treated as flanking regardless of positioning. In addition, they can flank a creature with improved uncanny dodge if the packmaster has at least 4 more levels than the target.

This ability replaces improved hit and run.

Pack Positioning (Ex)

At 15th level, the packmaster can use a standard action to grant a full round to one of their animal companions.

This ability replaces greater hit and run.
